Verified: fmt, clippy -p jackioh-server, cargo test -p jackioh-server (1613 pass), spec check, catalog check, patches check, classify (Internal). Nothing left but the final report.
Decisions: a key type K for `Kept` (not a sentinel ReportKey); KeptHistory keeps in-deck tallies only, not whole reports.
Dead ends: none. The load-count test fails on the old stats.rs (79 loads vs 2); the figures test passes on both (it pins unchanged output).

## Goal

`GET /api/stats/cards/:id` reads every shipped patch's history from **one** all-patch `statsTotals.load`. That load is kept for `CARD_STATS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` as one history per (`?pilot=`, `?mode=`), and every card's page shares it. The current patch's turn and co-played figures still come from its own kept report (`kept_report`, with drills). So a drill-down that misses makes at most two loads, however many patches ship (79 in `patches.json` today). When the four views (no mode, `bo1`, `bo3`, `random`) have each been opened, the next page within the TTL makes no load. Every figure stays byte for byte what it was. A new ruling, R2491000, amends R978000. Its §11 paragraph goes in `spec/pending/2491.md`, and §9.11 names it.
